claim.title: No early stopping needed: test error keeps decreasing up to 1e5 iterations (Fig. 3)
claim.statement: With U0=0.01I, m=5dr, r=5 and step size 0.0025, test error keeps decreasing gradually over 1e5 GD iterations and does not diverge, for d=100 and 200.
claim.test_plan: Run GD for 1e5 iterations with d∈{100,200} and log test error every 1e3 iterations.
claim.success_criterion: Test error at 1e5 iterations is ≤ test error at earlier checkpoints (e.g., 2e4) and shows no divergence; final test error is around 0.02 or below.
claim.success_criterion_source: Figure 3 shows test error ≤0.02 at the end
